title: GS21 type sign x productivity: six mirrored types gs_bv [-0.5, -0.3, -0.15, 0.15, 0.3, 0.5] on z~ (gs_bzi 1), gs_level ladder 0.5..2.0, no compensation, price 2.5 (KP14 vygelbc's construction)
question: Does the construction behind KP14's interaction gap (a mirrored type sign revealed by a size ladder, times one standardized within-firm state) give GS21 a fair gap of 0.1/yr (+0.029 monthly) when the state is the firm's productivity?
notes:
WHY (2026-11-01). The three interaction economies agree on the principle (exposure = product of two mean-zero firm factors, one carrying a sign no monotone sort reads) and differ in construction: BGN bvychs35 type x emergent claim leverage, GS21 gvyp15 productivity x coupon (no types), KP14 vygelbcs type x profitability deviation (bounded, price 4, sigma_eps 0.3). The construction every model can carry is 'type sign revealed by a level ladder x one within-firm state' (BGN cannot carry a within-firm product: its only project state is beta and project-level exposure diversifies inside the firm). This is GS21's version: the y exposure is gs_bv_f z~ (gs_bzl 0, gs_bzi 1), six mirrored gs_bv on the gs_level ladder 0.5..2.0 (vygelb's), bv_comp 0 (the exposure is mean zero in z~ so the level compensation is inert; the type shows in size only through gs_level). The exposure is the product of the type's sign (read from size) and the firm's productivity deviation (read from ROE / size), which no linear function of the characteristics spans.

PREDICTION (2026-11-01): oracle room 40% or more (both factors mean zero, as vygelbc 40-90%) and a fair gap of +0.02 to +0.08 at the larger ladder; gvyp15's productivity x coupon gave +0.078 with no types. FALSIFIED if room is at or below gvy25s's 11% on three seeds.
